arStrings.szText: (chuckles) Ohh, it is high time I admitted that I am a poor adventurer. I have roamed this murky wood for hours, and my only clue? That damned three-faced statue.
“Behold the truths that lie within,” the inscription said. Are those your words, Jered? Telling me I had the answer all along? That my own selfishness pushed my family away? That alone...I am lost.
I have been lost since before I left Tristram. Found at last for a wonderful moment when I put down my nonsense and made myself useful to others.
It has been good traveling with you, Jered. But I believe it is time I went home, to the people I have left, and made myself useful there.
